question: The ______ of every state unfurls the flag in its capital on the Republic Day.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Governor**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Governor is the constitutional head of a state in India, appointed by the President of India.
 
• On Republic Day, the Governor unfurls the national flag at the state capital as part of the official celebration.
 
• The Governor's role is to represent the central government in the state and act according to the advice of the state's Council of Ministers.
 
• The Governor has various powers and functions including legislative, executive, and discretionary powers as outlined in the Constitution of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Republic Day**

 
 
• Republic Day in India is celebrated on January 26th every year to honor the date on which the Constitution of India came into effect in 1950.
 
• It marks the transition of India from a British Dominion to a republic.
 
• The day is celebrated with grand parades in the national capital, New Delhi, and state capitals, showcasing India's defense capability, cultural and social heritage.
 
 
 
• **Role of the Governor**
 
 
• The Governor is the nominal executive head of the state, functioning as a representative of the President of India.
 
• The Governor's powers and duties include summoning and proroguing the state legislature, granting pardons, and appointing the Chief Minister.
 
• Governors can also reserve bills passed by the state legislature for the President's consideration.
 
 
 
• **Chief Minister**
 
 
• The Chief Minister is the head of the government in a state and is responsible for running the state administration.
 
• They are appointed by the Governor and are usually the leader of the majority party in the state legislature.
 
• The Chief Minister advises the Governor on various matters related to the state's governance.
